assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about relational schema relationships.
assets.alt_text: Relational modeling diagram from entities to keys, foreign-key relationships, and integrity checks.
assets.caption: Use keys and constraints to keep linked records consistent.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about transaction lifecycle.
assets.alt_text: A transaction flow from BEGIN through read/write work and validation to COMMIT or ROLLBACK.
assets.caption: Practice both commit and rollback in a disposable database.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about mvcc and row visibility.
assets.alt_text: MVCC visual: transaction start, row versions, snapshot visibility, and cleanup of old versions.
assets.caption: Consider both what a transaction can see and when cleanup can act.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about index design trade-offs.
assets.alt_text: Index workflow from workload definition through operator/column choice and query-plan measurement to write/storage cost review.
assets.caption: Add indexes based on measured workloads rather than intuition.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about reading a query plan.
assets.alt_text: Plan analysis proceeds from estimates and access paths to actual row/time evidence and hypothesis comparison.
assets.caption: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement; use safe SELECTs in a lab.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about jsonb query path.
assets.alt_text: JSONB workflow from document validation to access operators, justified indexes and result verification.
assets.caption: Retain relational constraints for core business invariants.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about full-text search pipeline.
assets.alt_text: Search flow from text normalization through tsvector and tsquery to relevance ranking.
assets.caption: Test language configuration and search ranking with representative text.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about row-level security checks.
assets.alt_text: Row-level security checks include the role, table privilege, policy and owner/bypass behavior.
assets.caption: Test with the real restricted role and multiple tenant identities.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about backup and recovery workflow.
assets.alt_text: Recovery flow from recovery objective to backup/archive, isolated restore, and data verification.
assets.caption: A successful dump is not proof that restoration will work.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about replication topology.
assets.alt_text: Primary server WAL changes ship to a standby; replay lag and failover require monitoring and rehearsal.
assets.caption: Replication needs WAL-retention, lag and recovery monitoring.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about application-to-database flow.
assets.alt_text: App flow from input validation through bound parameters and transactions to error handling and connection close.
assets.caption: Parameterize values; never concatenate untrusted input into SQL.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about connection pool lifecycle.
assets.alt_text: A pooled connection is acquired, used for bounded work, resolved by commit/rollback, and returned clean.
assets.caption: Do not return a connection with an open transaction or leaked session state.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about backward-compatible migration.
assets.alt_text: A migration release adds schema, deploys compatible code, backfills and verifies, then removes old structures later.
assets.caption: Test migrations against populated data before deployment.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Focused concept visual about extension and foreign-data boundary.
assets.alt_text: Extension/FDW workflow includes provenance, privileges, a sandbox test and upgrade/failure checks.
assets.caption: PostGIS and other specialist extensions are optional, environment-dependent dependencies.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf teaching diagram authored for the PostgreSQL course; no external artwork.
